title: Career Roadmap: Site Admin
summary: Career Domain: Architecture, Construction & Built Environment · Qualification Pathway: BBA / BMS / BBM – BBA - Real Estate / Construction Management · Target Career: Site Admin

facts.Current degree: BBA / BMS / BBM (Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Site Admin runs the administration of a construction site: labour records, materials, stores, documents, safety paperwork and coordination with the head office, so engineers can focus on building.

items.text: Maintain labour attendance, payroll inputs and contractor records
Track material receipts, stores and stock
Handle site documents, permits and compliance registers
Visit construction sites to see how they run
Study construction materials, stores and procurement
Learn labour laws (BOCW Act, contract labour) and safety basics
Learn an ERP or inventory tool
Intern at a construction site office
Prepare sample site registers and reports
Apply for site admin and stores roles
